fixtures.name: Minimal
fixtures.purpose: Small useful page or landing section.
fixtures.stress: Framework overhead, cold-start cost, and minimum payload.
limits: Not representative of dense application UI.

fixtures.name: Docs
fixtures.purpose: Dense article, navigation, code blocks, and tables.
fixtures.stress: Documentation layout, typography, and nested content.
limits: Does not model frequent runtime mutation.

fixtures.name: Dashboard
fixtures.purpose: Repeated cards, tables, filters, charts, and states.
fixtures.stress: Rule reuse, duplicated utilities, and large DOM.
limits: Chart visuals are fixture placeholders, not a chart-library benchmark.

fixtures.name: Stress CSS
fixtures.purpose: Controlled small, medium, and large CSS outputs.
fixtures.stress: Browser style calculation as CSS volume grows.

metrics.label: Total diagnostic duration
metrics.description: Total elapsed time for the diagnostic runner path.

metrics.label: Generated CSS raw bytes
metrics.description: Raw bytes of diagnostic generated CSS.

metrics.label: Generated CSS gzip bytes

metrics.description: Brotli bytes of diagnostic generated CSS.

metrics.description: Time spent initializing the CSS scanner in the CLI-equivalent path.

metrics.label: CLI CSS entry registration
metrics.description: Time spent finding and registering managed CSS entries.

metrics.label: CLI source glob
metrics.description: Time spent resolving CLI source file patterns.

metrics.label: CLI source scan
metrics.description: Time spent scanning fixture source files.

metrics.label: CLI CSS extraction
metrics.description: Time spent creating extracted Master CSS.

metrics.label: CLI file write

metrics.label: Vite baseline build
metrics.description: Vite production build time for the fixture without Master CSS plugin work.

metrics.label: Vite total build
metrics.description: Total Vite production build time with instrumented Master CSS plugin work.

metrics.label: Vite scanner init
metrics.description: Time spent initializing the Master CSS scanner during Vite config resolution.

metrics.label: Vite module scan
metrics.description: Time spent scanning transformed Vite modules.

metrics.label: Vite style entry
metrics.description: Time spent handling Master CSS style entry transforms and virtual CSS loads.

metrics.label: Vite bundle CSS extraction
metrics.description: Time spent extracting generated CSS and splicing it into the final CSS bundle.

limits: This suite is diagnostic and does not replace end-user production command timing from build-performance.
CLI diagnostics mirror the scan and extraction pipeline in-process, so child-process startup and package loader cost are intentionally excluded.
Vite diagnostics instrument Master CSS plugin hooks and include a Vite baseline metric for context.
Do not use diagnostic numbers as permission to change CSS output, cascade order, source detection, hydration, or public behavior.
